title: Captain Hollanda Lima's encounter with a being in a space suit

tellings.quote: He himself actually saw an alien being that was in a space suit and and the the being sort of gave him a hug

plain: A Brazilian military officer, Captain Uyrangê Hollanda Lima, says he met a being in a space suit near Colares in northern Brazil, and the being gave him a hug. Michels tells this from the report of Operation Prato, the Brazilian military's investigation into strange sightings around Colares in the late 1970s, which Hollanda led. If true, the man in charge of the official inquiry had a close encounter himself.
